$comment: Dependencies without a 'platform' field are built by vcpkg on every platform.
Qt and OpenCV are taken from the distribution on Linux: vcpkg's qtbase needs a
pile of apt-installed X11/GL/fontconfig headers there regardless, so building it
from source would cost an hour of CI and buy nothing.
opencv4 rather than the opencv wrapper port: default-features:false on
the wrapper does not reach opencv4, which then resolves with its full
default set -- dnn (protobuf + flatbuffers + abseil, some 15 minutes of
CI), gapi, quirc, tiff and webp, none of which opentrack uses. Asking
for opencv4 directly gets just libjpeg-turbo, libpng and zlib.
core, imgproc, imgcodecs, video, videoio, features2d and flann are not
dependencies.name: opencv4
